assets.style: Cinematic semi-realistic digital painting, dramatic high-contrast lighting, warm golden light on the face against deep teal and violet shadows, emotional and intense, sharp focus on the eyes, one clear focal subject. The right half of the image is dark, calm, empty space for a title. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
